schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

customManagers.description: Track the explicit Corepack pin in the Dockerfile, devcontainer, and README install instructions — none of Renovate's built-in managers see a version embedded in a shell command or prose.

packageRules.description: typescript-eslint peers typescript <6.1.0; TS 7 breaks type-aware lint (see CLAUDE.md)

Stay on Node 24 LTS until the planned move to Node 26 after 2026-10-28. Covers every Node version pin in the repo: the docker `node` image (Dockerfile), `.nvmrc` and `actions/setup-node`'s `node-version:` (both the node-version datasource, depName `node`), and the devcontainer's `mcr.microsoft.com/devcontainers/typescript-node` image tag.
